content.question: What is the difference between the Skip-gram and CBOW variants of word2vec?
options: Skip-gram predicts the center word from the surrounding context, while CBOW predicts the surrounding context words from the center word.
Skip-gram predicts the surrounding context words from the center word, while CBOW predicts the center word from the surrounding context.
Skip-gram works on characters, while CBOW works on whole words.
Skip-gram uses global co-occurrence counts, while CBOW uses only local counts.
content.answer: Skip-gram predicts the surrounding context words from the center word, while CBOW predicts the center word from the surrounding context.
